title: Choose UpClose's visual world (safer hand)
question: Familiar directions from the driver's world. Pick one, the category standard, or re-roll again.

options.label: Guide Sign
options.lineage: highway guide signs: reflective green panels, white Highway Gothic lettering, amber warning diamonds
options.thesis: Wayfinding for a walkaround: big, calm, outdoor-legible signage that tells the buyer exactly where to film next and what was found.
materials: rounded sign corners with an inset white border
options.viewport: A white concrete page with one huge green guide panel spanning the width: 'Good find. Look closer.' in Highway Gothic-style lettering, an exit-style arrow action, and the car below with amber diamonds on its findings.
options.risk: It can feel municipal, and the green echoes the old incumbent palette, so the green has to be a signage green, not a muted sage.

options.label: Paint Chip Card
options.lineage: factory paint-code chip cards and body-colour swatch books
options.thesis: A factory colour card for condition: white card stock, glossy chips, and printed codes, where each zone is a chip that is filled, flagged, or left blank.
materials: glossy colour chips with printed codes
options.viewport: A white card page with the headline set large at the top left, the car photo as one big glossy chip, and the 8 zones as a row of chips with codes beneath; the action is the solid blue chip.
options.risk: It can drift into a paint-store look, and the chip grid can collapse into a row of equal cards.

options.label: Evidence File
options.lineage: an adjuster's photo file: manila folder, glossy prints with orange date stamps, typed labels
options.thesis: Every finding is a print in the file, with its timestamp burned into the corner: UpClose as the evidence folder you take to the seller.
materials: manila folder stock with a tab
options.viewport: An open manila folder filling the viewport: the headline is typed on the tab label, three findings are prints with orange time stamps clipped inside, and the action is the blue 'Open a new file' button on the folder's edge.
options.risk: Insurance-file cues can suggest an accident claim, and the folder can tip into skeuomorphic costume.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The used-car web canon as Carvana, CarGurus and CARFAX ship it: white ground, one strong blue, big car photography, a clean report UI.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA over a large car photo, with a 3-step row and a report preview below, at Carvana-level polish.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every listing site by design.
